source: MODELLED, not measured. A smooth two-lobe intensity distribution with an asymmetric cut-off, fitted so that every UN Regulation No. 112 Rev.4 Class B passing-beam limit (para 6.2.4: nine test points, the grouped minima at points 1-8, and zones I, III and IV) is satisfied by construction. Compliance is verified numerically by scripts/build_headlamp_pattern.py before the artifact is written. R112 constrains only 9L..9R by 4U..4D; cells outside that box are the model's own extrapolation and are labelled 'modelled_beyond_regulated_domain'. This is a plausible compliant design, not a measured lamp. Variant 'wide': the model's own falloff continues beyond 9 degrees horizontally.
